summary.text: The recipe for rank nine sovereign immortal fetus Gu, grown out of Shadow Sect's life-and-death immortal aperture revival method and finished by Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's own main body after tens of thousands of years of planning.

claims.text: At the climax of the battle of Yi Tian Mountain, the ten extreme immortal zombies inside the ten extreme formation are fully spent and Spectral Soul touches the newly finished rank nine Immortal Gu. He names it sovereign immortal fetus Gu and calls it the fruit of tens of thousands of years of plotting and painstaking effort, a Gu that would let him surpass every venerable in history and take the body of an otherworldly demon.

The refinement first raises the ten extreme immortal zombies into the ten extreme immortal zombie lifeless formation, then draws on the bodies and immortal apertures of countless Southern Border Gu Immortals who died in the fighting as Gu refinement material, then sends over a hundred Zombie Alliance immortal zombies into the formation. Finally the Demon Venerable spares no sacrifice of himself to activate the ten extreme formation, and the grand tribulations and myriad tribulations that follow complete the feat. Just gathering all ten of the ten extreme physiques takes tens of thousands of years of planning, waiting, and luck, and every step of the process is stated to be beyond what a rank eight Gu Immortal could manage.

The revival method behind the recipe starts as Shadow Sect’s life-and-death immortal aperture revival method, goes through many failed experiments, and is modified step by step at great cost before Spectral Soul’s own main body joins the work, using the essence of human path, transformation path, and heaven path to finish the Immortal Gu recipe for sovereign immortal fetus Gu. Fang Yuan seizes the finished Gu and its nine-five sovereign immortal aperture before Spectral Soul can use it, turning Shadow Sect’s years of effort to nothing in a single stroke.

Refinement materials.text: the ten extreme immortal zombies bodies and immortal apertures of Southern Border Gu Immortals who died in the battle over a hundred Zombie Alliance immortal zombies

Holders.text: Spectral Soul Demon Venerable (creator) Shadow Sect (creator)
